rollbackPlan.plan: Preserve the current active tenant data version pointer captured by the future promotion command before any active pointer change. Preserve the prior active tenant data version for 30 days and keep this candidate version inactive until an explicit promotion gate changes the active pointer. If promotion is later rejected or rolled back, restore the prior active pointer and keep this candidate inactive for audit review.
